reason: The collagen framework and mineral suggest the first step toward making strong bone.
expectation: The mineral will strengthen the bone framework.

effect: The mineralised framework now shows how collagen and mineral contribute different properties to bone. I’ll add the living cells next.
reaction: The contrast between toughness and resistance to compression is helpful.
reason: Bone cells seem necessary to make the mineralised framework living bone.
expectation: The bone cells will become part of the mineralised framework.

effect: The bone cells are embedded in the mineralised matrix. Blood vessels look like the next part needed for living bone.
reaction: The cutaway makes the cells’ location clear.
reason: Blood vessels can supply the living bone tissue.
expectation: The vessels will join the bones and support their living cells.

effect: The vessels supply the cells within the bone matrix. The bones now need a smooth joint surface.
reaction: The connection between blood supply and living bone is clear.
reason: Articular cartilage looks suited to covering the ends of the bones at the elbow.
expectation: The cartilage will cover the joint surfaces and help them move smoothly.

effect: The cartilage now covers the facing elbow surfaces, allowing them to slide against each other. The joint still needs its capsule and support.
reaction: The sliding inset makes the cartilage’s role clear.
reason: The synovial capsule appears to enclose the joint and provide fluid for movement.
expectation: The capsule will enclose the elbow joint and help its surfaces move smoothly.

effect: The capsule encloses the joint, and its lining supplies fluid that helps the cartilage surfaces glide. The elbow still needs ligament support.
reaction: The lining’s role in supplying fluid is a useful detail.
reason: The elbow ligaments are the remaining visible part and should support the joint.
expectation: The ligaments will span and support the elbow joint.

effect: The ligaments complete the movable arm skeleton, supporting the elbow against sideways movement while allowing it to bend.
reaction: The arrows make the ligaments’ supporting role clear.

mostWorthwhile.text: Adding mineral to the collagen framework was most worthwhile because the result explained how the two materials contribute different properties to bone.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the bone cells was the least engaging step: the cutaway showed where they sit but gave little explanation of what they do.

surprise.text: I learned that the capsule’s lining supplies fluid that helps the cartilage-covered surfaces glide.

arbitrary.text: None of the combinations felt particularly arbitrary; the item names and pictures suggested their roles, although the sequence became predictable.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter to see how the muscle and skeleton work together. The connections between tissue structure and function held my interest, even though the choices here were mostly straightforward.
